changeSet.author: alfcheun
changeSet.comment: Add STRATEGY_ID + STRATEGY_VID to BT.RESULT for direct strategy joins
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE BT.RESULT ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS STRATEGY_ID UUID; ALTER TABLE BT.RESULT ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS STRATEGY_VID INTEGER;

changeSet.author: alfcheun
changeSet.comment: Backfill STRATEGY_ID/STRATEGY_VID from BT.QUEUE (latest VID per QUEUE_ID)
changeSet.sql: UPDATE BT.RESULT R SET STRATEGY_ID = Q.STRATEGY_ID, STRATEGY_VID = Q.STRATEGY_VID FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (QUEUE_ID) QUEUE_ID, STRATEGY_ID, STRATEGY_VID FROM BT.QUEUE WHERE STRATEGY_ID IS NOT NULL ORDER BY QUEUE_ID, QUEUE_VID DESC ) Q WHERE Q.QUEUE_ID = R.QUEUE_ID AND R.STRATEGY_ID IS NULL;

changeSet.author: alfcheun
changeSet.comment: Index BT.RESULT by strategy for catalog and promotion lookups
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS IX_RESULT_STRATEGY ON BT.RESULT (STRATEGY_ID, STRATEGY_VID, CREATED_AT DESC);

changeSet.author: alfcheun
changeSet.comment: SP_INS_RESULT — denormalize STRATEGY_ID/STRATEGY_VID from BT.QUEUE at insert

changeSet.author: alfcheun
changeSet.comment: Drop legacy 2-arg SP_GET_STRATEGY_LIST (superseded by IN_IS_BEST_IND variant)
changeSet.sql: DROP PROCEDURE IF EXISTS BT.SP_GET_STRATEGY_LIST(TEXT, INTEGER, REFCURSOR, TEXT, TEXT, TEXT);
